A beginner usually just needs two things to get started: (1) a clear goal (comfort/support for a specific area), and (2) the right fit/size (measure and use the size chart on the product page).
If you’re shopping for a dog coat, a quick back-length measurement is the key. If you’re shopping for a support like an ankle strap, choosing the right size is the main thing.
